title: How bad was Minnesota's "worst in a decade" blizzard?
description:
All video is from the Twin Cities Metro Area on December 23, 2020. 

This video is being published on YouTube to provide educational, newsworthy and safety content as this storm continues to impact much of Minnesota and especially the Twin Cities.
